action_items: OPTIONAL a11y: add DialogDescription to encaissement dialog to silence Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: create_sale: non_paye path resets amount_paid=0 BEFORE customer_name resolution — correct order maintained.
customer_name resolution triggered only when customer_name missing or equal to 'Client Comptoir' — good.
reports/daily by_method 'sales_cash' clamps initial payment to min(initial, total) to avoid over-counting when there is monnaie rendue — good.
reports/daily uses lexicographic string date range ($gte T00:00:00, $lte T23:59:59.999999) — consistent with rest of codebase (created_at stored as isoformat strings).
UnpaidInvoices.load: on first load knownIds.current is null, so no toast on initial (avoids spurious startup notifications) — good.
playChime uses shared audioCtx; if browser autoplay policy blocks it, silently caught — acceptable.
handleQuickSearch: digits.padStart(4,'0') matches on '-0002' suffix; also falls back to endsWith(ref) — robust for barcode / partial input.
SETTLEMENT_METHODS filters out saleOnly:true — non_paye correctly hidden in settlement Selects. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all iter5 flows verified across admin + caissier)
